prompts.ideas.names.short: Come up with 10 name ideas for [what it is].
prompts.ideas.names.detailed: Come up with 15 names for [what it is]. Context: [what it's about and who it's for]. Desired mood: [mood]. Group them: descriptive, figurative, short invented words. For each, one phrase on why it fits. Avoid well-known brands.
prompts.ideas.names.refine: I like [options]. Give me 10 more in the same spirit.
prompts.ideas.names.check: The name “[name]”: is it easy to say, remember and spell from hearing it? Any risks?
prompts.ideas.project.detailed: Suggest 8 project ideas on “[topic]” for [who's doing it]. Constraints: [time], [resources]. For each: the gist in one phrase, the final output, skills needed, difficulty from 1 to 3. Add 2 unusual ideas that seem odd at first glance.
prompts.ideas.project.refine: Combine ideas [numbers] into one and describe the result.
prompts.ideas.project.check: I've picked [idea]. What 3 questions should I ask myself before starting?
prompts.ideas.approaches.short: Suggest 4 different approaches to this problem: [problem]
prompts.ideas.approaches.detailed: Problem: [problem]. Suggest 4 fundamentally different approaches, not variations on one. Table: approach, gist, what's needed, pros, cons, when it's the best choice. Include one approach that seems non-obvious.
prompts.ideas.approaches.refine: How would [someone: an artist, an engineer, a child] approach this problem?
prompts.ideas.approaches.check: I'm leaning towards [approach]. What could go wrong?
prompts.ideas.expand.detailed: Here's a rough idea: [idea]. Help me develop it with questions and options: who it's for, what problem it solves, what a first version might look like, what could be added later, what it resembles and how it differs. Ask me the 3 questions whose answers would sharpen it most.
prompts.ideas.expand.refine: Here are my answers: [answers]. How has the idea changed now?
prompts.ideas.expand.check: Describe my idea in one sentence. If you can't, what's still unclear about it?
prompts.ideas.group.detailed: Here's a list of ideas from a brainstorm: [ideas]. Group them into 3–6 named groups. Merge duplicates within groups. Separately list the ideas that didn't fit any group: they may be the most interesting. Don't drop anything.
prompts.ideas.group.refine: Which group is weakest? Suggest 3 ideas to strengthen it.
prompts.ideas.group.check: Here's how I grouped them: [groups]. Where would you do it differently and why?
prompts.ideas.criteria.short: Compare the ideas [ideas] by these criteria: [criteria]
prompts.ideas.criteria.detailed: Compare the ideas: [ideas]. Criteria: [criteria]. A table scoring each criterion 1–5 with a short reason for each score. Don't just add up the scores: ask me which criteria matter more, and only then give a total.
prompts.ideas.criteria.refine: [criterion] matters most to me. Recalculate the total with that in mind.
prompts.ideas.criteria.check: Which important criterion is missing from my list?
prompts.ideas.first.short: What's the simplest first step for this idea: [idea]?
prompts.ideas.first.detailed: Idea: [idea]. I have [time] and [resources]. Suggest 5 possible first steps, each doable today in under an hour. For each: what to do, what the result will be, what it'll tell me about the idea.
prompts.ideas.first.refine: I did [step] and here's the result: [result]. What's next?
prompts.ideas.first.check: Why might I be putting this step off? Suggest an even simpler version.
prompts.ideas.budget.short: How can I do [idea] on a budget of [budget]?
prompts.ideas.budget.detailed: I want to make [idea] happen on a budget of [budget]. Suggest 3 versions: free, minimal, optimal. For each: what's included, what has to be simplified, where to get materials free or on loan. Don't give exact prices, just the rough level of cost.
prompts.ideas.budget.refine: What could be replaced by sharing or swapping with others?
prompts.ideas.budget.check: Here's my list of costs: [costs]. What can go without losing the core?
prompts.ideas.toplan.short: Turn the idea into a plan for [time]: [idea]
prompts.ideas.toplan.detailed: Idea: [idea]. Timeframe: [time]. Make a plan: 3–5 stages, each with concrete tasks, the stage's output, and how to know it's done. Mark the riskiest stage and what to do if it takes longer.
prompts.ideas.toplan.refine: Make a simpler version of the plan in case I have half the time.
prompts.ideas.toplan.check: I'm at the [stage] stage, and I've done [done]. Am I on track?
prompts.ideas.weak.short: Find the weak spots in this idea: [idea]
prompts.ideas.weak.detailed: Play an honest critic of this idea: [idea]. Find 5 weak spots: who might not need it, what might not work, what already exists, which resources are underestimated, what the risks are. For each, suggest how to test whether the problem is real and how to reduce it.
prompts.ideas.weak.refine: Now name 3 strengths worth keeping as I rework it.
prompts.ideas.weak.check: I've changed the idea like this: [changes]. Are the main problems solved?

verify.ideas.names: Before using a name, search to check it isn't taken and has no unexpected meaning in other languages.
verify.ideas.project: AI ideas are starting points. Pick one that genuinely interests you: you'll be working on it for a while.
verify.ideas.approaches: Judge the approaches yourself: the AI doesn't know your strengths, time and constraints better than you do.
verify.ideas.expand: Developing an idea can easily drift off course. Keep checking against the original goal.
verify.ideas.group: Group names are your tool. If they don't help you think, rename them.
verify.ideas.criteria: The AI's scores are opinion, not calculation. Pay special attention to criteria that depend on your situation.
verify.ideas.first: A first step should take no more than an hour. If it's longer, break it down.
verify.ideas.budget: Prices change and depend on the city. Check current costs yourself.
verify.ideas.toplan: The timings in the AI's plan are estimates. Compare them with your own schedule.
verify.ideas.weak: The AI's criticism may be too generic. Look for weak spots that apply to your specific situation.
